name: decision-interview
description: Ask the minimum decision questions needed before turning the task into canonical implementation rules, on behavior, data integrity, rollout safety, or test strategy. Use when missing information is decision-driven (not factual) or undecided policy blocks planning; in an attended chain it records an open decision as provisional and continues. Do not use for factual gaps (use targeted-questions), when decisions are locked, or when implementation has no correctness-critical ambiguity. To harden wording use contract-signoff; for contradictory rules use resolve-contract-gaps.
